name: dap-portal
comment: The sample-data layer is the brand catalogue, not a marker-string fixture set: with sampleData true this edition carries 97 product rows across 21 groups (16 browsable + the 5 PIM tree rows sample-data 5.0.0 adds), the three personas on account TC-100200 and the buyer's orders, quotes, carts and favourite lists (sample-data 6.x, USD), which is what the Product Assets and Search results surfaces list. sample-data 6.1.0 also ships the Truvio copy for the DAP header, footer and home poster as declared replace overrides at surface-dap-portal's own paths, the way it replaces surface-swift's Placeholder slots for swift-demo. expectedCounts is pinned rather than derived because Set-ConfigFromEdition derives EcomProducts/EcomGroups from the toggle alone and carries the pre-4.0.0 figures. MEASURED (Foundry remote delivery 20260925-105239 on foundry-dap.mydwsite4.com): the sample-data documents at surface-swift's 'Swift 2' paths compose with no Content predicate in this edition (the only one is surface-dap-portal's area 26 Replace entry), so they are inert, and area 26 held only Digital Assets Portal pages after the delivery. themes: default is what gives the header mega-menu its affordance CSS (caret, hover bridge); without a theme the Foundry affordance leg has no subject.
description: Digital Asset Portal edition: framework-only base + sample data + the Digital Assets Portal content surface (area 26 on Swift-v2 item types - the item-type definitions come from the host's Swift design-package overlay, not from base content) on the default theme. The header is the Swift mega-menu: Help and About are public sections with child pages, and Product Assets and Digital Assets join them for a signed-in partner. In layers/INDEX.json gateProven.editions since run 20260925-105239 (foundry-dap.mydwsite4.com); last proven as dap-portal 2.5.0 by run 20261020-091906 on DW 10.29.8 (Distribution #120). INDEX gateProven is the record.
